The Analytics Engine team hosted the (Re)Introduction to Cal-Adapt webinar to showcase the updated Cal-Adapt.org platform and its integration with the Analytics Engine. The session provided an overview of new tools and datasets developed to support climate resilience and planning efforts across California.
